name: RC-B10-0175/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the severe political, humanitarian and human rights crisis in Sudan, in particular the sexual violence and child rape
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and asking others to act on Sudan's crisis. It calls on all sides in the fighting to stop, let aid through, and end sexual violence and child rape. It asks European Union countries to sanction those responsible, back international investigations, and give more humanitarian aid, including support for survivors of sexual violence.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is a formal request, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Sudan's warring sides, their commanders, and civilians, especially women and children.
- **What happens next:** European Union governments decide whether to impose sanctions and send more aid.
